info.name: api.video
info.description:
Stream your videos on your website or your application within few lines of codes! Our cloud infrastructure allows you to host and broadcast your on demand and live videos worldwide thanks to our CDN. We encode on the go to facilitate immediate playback, enhancing viewer experiences across multiple devices and platforms. 

To get started create your account [here](https://my.api.video)

item.name: Captions
item.description:
You can add as many subtitle tracks as you want to a video.

One of the subtitles may be used as a default track, which will be loaded in the player automatically.
